body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.52 (naive base rate 0.45) that: HDFC Life FY27 value of new business (VNB) grows ≥12.0% YoY. Evidence: H1 FY27 call (15-Oct-2026): H1 VNB ₹2,037 cr (+12%), Q2 VNB +15%; new-business margin 24.7% (H1 FY26 24.5%); individual APE +9% H1, total APE +11% H1 / +13% Q2; HDFC Bank channel APE +12% in Q2 ('growth momentum coming back'). MD: 'momentum is building… VNB growth ahead of APE'; GST impact 'now gets baked into the business model from second half'. Headwinds: H2 FY26 protection grew 57% (base effect), ULIP persistency softer, IRDAI consultation papers on distribution economics. FY26 (Q4 FY26 call, Apr-2026): VNB ₹4,034 cr (+2%), margin 24.2% (25.5% ex GST/SSV). Reasoning: Management tone is the most upbeat in two years and the GST drag on margins laps in H2, so H2 VNB growth ≥12% is plausible; but the 57% protection base and IRDAI commission rules are real. Tone slightly ahead of what H1 numbers alone imply; we are a bit above base. Resolution: YES if HDFC Life's reported FY27 VNB ÷ FY26 VNB (₹4,034 cr, or FY26 as restated in the Q4 FY27 deck) − 1 ≥ 12.0%, using the company's stated growth if given. Source: HDFC Life Q4 FY27 investor presentation / earnings call (NSE). Resolve by 2027-05-15; score with Brier vs base rate.

body: Forward test of the valuation-temperature method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.52 (naive base rate 0.48) that: Adobe's share price return from 20-Nov-2026 to 30-Jun-2027 beats SPY's price return. Evidence: Yahoo monthly closes: ADBE $217.71 on 20-Nov-2026 (52-wk $190.12–362.71; all-time high ~$670); SPY $689.81. Q3 FY26 release (Sep-2026): record revenue $6.76bn (+13%), non-GAAP EPS $6.13, GAAP EPS $4.62, ARR $27.50bn, AI-first ARR +150%; FY26 revenue target raised to $26.576–26.626bn; Q4 target $6.80–6.85bn; CEO succession under way ('Anil' named as successor) and an interim CFO. ≈9× annualised non-GAAP EPS / ≈12× GAAP — very cold vs its own 10-year history (typically 25–45×, from memory). Reasoning: Valuation-temperature test on a 'cold' quality name: double-digit growth at a single-digit-teens multiple is extreme for a software franchise, but the market is pricing AI disruption of creative tools, and cold-for-a-reason names often stay cold. Mean reversion is a weak 7-month force; we lean only slightly above the base. Resolution: YES if (ADBE close on 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 217.71) > (SPY close on 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 689.81). Use the last trading day ≤30-Jun-2027; adjust for splits; dividends ignored. Source: Yahoo Finance / Nasdaq closes (ADBE, SPY). Resolve by 2027-06-30; score with Brier vs base rate.
